headline: After 60 Years Apart, Glasgow Woman, 104, Reunites With Her Brother
meta_description: Susan Gair of Pollok turned 104 this summer and met her brother William again after six decades apart when he moved to London.
summary_short: Susan Gair of Pollok celebrated her 104th birthday this summer with an unexpected gift: a reunion with her brother William after 60 years.
body:
Susan Gair of Pollok turned 104 this summer and experienced a reunion decades in the making. Her brother William, now 86, had left for London approximately 60 years ago—a separation that spanned most of their adult lives.

The two siblings' long absence from each other speaks to how life's distances can stretch across decades. William's move south had kept them apart through countless seasons, but this summer brought them back together.

For Susan, reaching 104 years old and seeing her brother again marks a rare moment of connection—a reminder that some bonds, no matter how much time passes, remain worth celebrating.
quick_facts: Susan Gair of Pollok is 104 years old
Her brother William is 86 and lives in London
They were apart for approximately 60 years
They reunited during Susan's 104th birthday summer
